archive: archive/ holds past editions: read only, never run; to rerun one, use the old release install.
step: a release proof, not a loop step: the isolation check run_all_tests_v1.py runs every test through (current: run_all_tests_v1 uses it)
question: Did this run import code only from the Alarm folder and the interpreter, and open no file under a forbidden folder?

commands.name: run
commands.does: runs one script of this Alarm folder as __main__ with its arguments, then prints ISOLATION OK or FAILED

args.name: --forbid
args.meaning: a folder no file may be opened under (repeatable); without it, the defaults written in the code (the dev trees, when they exist)

args.name: script.py
args.meaning: a script inside this Alarm folder (a test or a tool)

commands.writes: nothing itself; the script writes what it writes

refuses.when: no script (prints its usage) or a script outside this Alarm folder (NOT IN THIS ALARM FOLDER)
ISOLATION FAILED: a module from outside, or a file opened under a forbidden folder

rules: otherwise the exit code is the script's own
it reads no settings file: pass --forbid (run_all_tests_v1 passes the settings' FORBID); for a real run use run_isolated_v2
its default forbidden folders are written in its code (MACHINE_PATHS_KNOWN.tsv lists them as KNOWN)

outputs.where: stdout, last line, when the run is isolated
stdout, last line, when it is not

dry_run_data: planted by _tools/tests/test_agent_docs_v1.py in a new temp folder: {SETTINGS} its settings file, {WORLD} the folder, {ALARM} this Alarm folder; run AD1_20261029, idea FLOWX
